All 3 refutation orderings (push-then-sync, sync-then-push, cap-shift edge) fail to produce a duplicate. Tests test_output_tail_replace_clears_prior_rows_and_reseeds + poll test (asserts count==1) pass. Verdict pass-with-followups because refutation surfaced one genuine latent defect not covered by either criterion for bounded output.

followups.title: 500-line cap-shift freezes long-spawn watch tails
followups.detail: Count-based cursor (agent_watch.py:1985-1987, len(lines)>cursor) vs the shifting lines[-500:] window (agent_watch.py:722, _OUTPUT_BACKFILL_LIMIT=500) means once a spawn exceeds 500 output lines len(lines) plateaus at 500 while the window shifts forward, so the tail freezes at the first 500-line window and drops later chunks. Use a content/seq identity anchor instead of len().

HOWEVER, the wave leaves the test suite RED: it enlarged the bodies but regenerated only the plugin_install (claude + opencode) agent goldens, missing the subagent_spec role-contract goldens (5 roles x 3 runtimes), the full-wave-spec golden, and the codex executor agent toml golden. 18 tests fail at HEAD; I confirmed the sampled three passed at base a0f9469b~1, so this is a regression introduced by this wave and a mandatory pre-iter-close followup.
